links.outcome: LLM agreement with expert clinicians on extraction difficulty grading versus interexpert agreement
links.effect: Interexpert kappa 0.754; GPT vs experts 0.564-0.590; Gemini 0.356-0.461; four-rater ICC 0.553; 95% limits of agreement about ±2 PDS points.
links.quote: Although agreement levels for LLMs remained below the substantial consensus observed between human specialists, GPT exhibited moderate agreement that remained below interexpert agreement.
